description: Launch documents and how dexcli agents-tui answers each: accepted (it goes on to the terminal and ready), or rejected with a launch_rejected code and exit code. dexcli here supports contract 1 with the modes chat, sessions, and connectors. A case has line (raw text), or launch (serialized compactly, then padded with spaces to pad_to_bytes when given), and the environment dexcli receives. Hand-written; see agents/cli/TERMINAL_UI_CONTRACT.md.
check_order: Report the first failure in this order: the line is at most 1 MiB, is UTF-8 JSON, is an object, and has type launch (invalid_launch, exit 2); contract is an integer this dexcli supports (contract_unsupported, exit 3); mode is a mode this dexcli runs for that contract (mode_unsupported, exit 3); the document passes the contract's schema (invalid_launch, exit 2); the variable dex.auth needs is set and not empty (auth_missing, exit 2). Each schema case has exactly one violation; an implementation passes it when the expected instance location and keyword are among its validator's errors.

cases.name: chat-resumed
cases.description: --resume: the terminal UI loads the history.

cases.name: chat-minimal
cases.description: No display, no images, no methods, empty capabilities: every feature that needs them is hidden.

cases.name: chat-models-and-reasoning-effort
cases.description: A chat with suggested models and reasoning effort values. dexcli 1.47.0 reads them; older releases ignore them.

cases.name: chat-launcher-session-switch
cases.description: The launcher opens the session a switch names. dexcli 1.47.2 reads it; older releases ignore it and switch in place.

cases.name: chat-tls
cases.description: TLS with a CA file and server name.

cases.name: chat-bearer-file
cases.description: Bearer token file named by DEX_CREDENTIAL_FILE.

cases.name: too-large
cases.description: 1 byte over 1 MiB, padded with spaces after the JSON.

cases.name: at-limit
cases.description: Exactly 1 MiB, padded with spaces after the JSON.

cases.name: mode-form
cases.description: form is reserved, not in contract 1.

cases.name: mode-missing-wins-over-schema
cases.description: An unknown mode is reported before schema errors.

cases.name: auth-carries-a-secret
cases.description: A secret value is never in the launch document.

cases.name: language-unknown
cases.description: Only Python and TypeScript commands launch it.

cases.name: reasoning-effort-value-uppercase
cases.description: A reasoning effort value is a lowercase name.

cases.name: reasoning-effort-value-default
cases.description: default is reserved for the terminal UI's /effort default.

cases.name: display-models-empty-id
cases.description: A suggested model ID is not empty.

cases.name: notice-level-unknown
cases.description: Notice levels are info, warning, and error.

cases.name: web-url-missing
cases.description: web_url is required; it may be null.

cases.name: web-url-null

cases.name: schema-error-wins-over-auth
cases.description: Schema errors are reported before a missing auth variable.
